definitions.explanation: The act of collecting specimens, samples, or items from nature for study or as a hobby.

notes:
{採集|さいしゅう} specifically refers to collecting things from nature—insects, plants, rocks, shells, etc. It implies going out and gathering specimens.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{採集|さいしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{昆虫|こんちゅう}→昆虫：05010_konchuu⟧{採集|さいしゅう}: insect collecting
- ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧{採集|さいしゅう}: plant collecting
- ⟦{標本|ひょうほん}→標本：13174_hyouhon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{採集|さいしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to collect specimens
